search_intent: vehicle price and quote verification Africa buyer verification
buyer_task: Verify the identity/version of the exact vehicle and the authenticity/reference basis of an Africa-bound quote (VIN, trim/MY, official reference price, quote stop rules) - NOT a full FOB/CIF corridor/freight/insurance/inland costing exercise.
scope_narrowing: Per 2026-09-09 instruction, paragraphs that replicate the full FOB/CIF corridor, ocean/inland freight, insurance-cover and inland-corridor costing are OUT_OF_SCOPE for this article: they belong to fob-cif-quote-check-africa and are moved to FACTS_NOT_ALLOWED_IN_BODY. URLs may remain listed but must not be used to support expanded corridor claims here.

source_registry.facts_supported: Incoterms(r) 2020 Checklist: FAS/FOB maritime/inland-waterway only; FCA for any mode incl multimodal and terminal delivery; C-group (CFR/CIF/CPT/CIP) are shipment contracts - risk passes on delivery (on board) in seller's country while seller pays main carriage; under CIF seller must arrange minimum-cover cargo insurance (LMA/IUA Clauses C or similar), CIP requires all-risk cover (Clauses A).

WCO Valuation FAQ: invoice/transaction price is not automatically customs value; whether freight/insurance is added depends on importing country national law; customs may reject declared value after persistent doubt; six valuation methods apply in sequence (transaction value, identical, similar, deductive, computed, fallback). Scope = global framework only, proves no national rule.
WTO Agreement on Implementation of Article VII GATT (customs valuation); framework not re-read this session; proves no national rule.

Vehicle duty calculated on CIF value; first purchase price depreciated 0-50% by age down to FOB, FX applied, then freight and insurance considered; ICUMS duty check needs VIN/chassis, model, year, make; clearing documents Bill of Lading or Waybill + Title; third-party charges include local shipping line charge paid to carrier and terminal handling charges; VAT on duty-inclusive value.

Public notice 30/05/2025: effective 1 July 2025 a new Current Retail Selling Price (CRSP) schedule is applied in computing customs value for imported used motor vehicles; schedule published on KRA website. Kenya national practice only.

Quality inspection of imports (Legal Notice 227/1995 and successors); imports not meeting Kenya standards are prohibited and returned at importer cost; pre-shipment inspection exists; at port of entry KEBS inspects entry form/packing list, samples, releases only compliant goods.
LPI 2.0 background not re-read; no country rule.

claims.claim: Identity/version must be frozen at VIN range, model year, exact trim, steering, powertrain and new/used condition before comparing prices (methodology anchored to authority data requirements).
claims.exact_support: GRA ICUMS requires VIN/model/year/make; consistent methodology.
claims.note: Methodology anchored in the fields authorities themselves require.

claims.claim: Invoice/quote price is not automatically customs value; national law decides treatment - the basis for treating a supplier quote as a reference, not a landed fact.
Ghana provides an official valuation reference path: CIF-based assessment with age depreciation and VIN-based duty check - an example of an official reference-price framework.
WTO Customs Valuation Agreement is the global treaty basis for transaction value (not reopened; used only as framework pointer).
Kenya publishes an official CRSP schedule used to compute used-vehicle customs value effective 1 July 2025 - an official reference-price table to test a used-car quote against.
Kenya KEBS inspection defines a conformity/identity gate a quoted vehicle must clear.
Incoterms define at which point price/risk transfer, used here only to label what a quoted price includes (identity of quote scope), not to cost the corridor.
claims.exact_support: ICC checklist, limited to scope labelling.

claims.claim: World Bank LPI is background and supplies no vehicle reference price.
Stop rule: pause when VIN, legal route, inspection scope, landed-cost line or service responsibility cannot be tied to one accountable party (methodology).
claims.exact_support: Procedural guidance, not an external factual assertion; requires no external source and must not be presented as a regulation.

facts_not_allowed_in_body: Full five-block ocean/inland corridor build-up, base ocean freight/surcharge/transshipment figures, CIF insurance-cover analysis, bonded transit and inland-delivery costing, destination disbursement schedules - OUT_OF_SCOPE, covered by fob-cif-quote-check-africa; do not present them here.
blocked_facts: C7 (LPI cannot support price); other African countries' official reference-price tables (only GH/KE captured); any live supplier price/quote authenticity for a specific VIN.
